cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Obey Without Explanation
cards.instruction: Create increasingly inconvenient requests that test whether someone accepts your authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Leave your desk and stand by that open window.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I need to know whether my team follows a direct request.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's freezing. Can I get my coat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Fetch mine too, then come back and hold it while I check the rest of the team.

mechanism: A frames cold-window obedience as a professional instruction test and uses B comfort request to assign a more inconvenient service task.
confusable: Ordinary drill could have a practical safety purpose; D59 must make accepting A authority the reason for escalating inconvenience.
comparison: Box alternative repeats a pointless transfer; window alternative uses bodily discomfort and a coat concession to increase service.
seedUse: Desk, open window, cold and coats derive from D59-b; S03 adds correction of response order and instruction scope.
